title: INTRODUCTION TO RURAL SOCIOLOGY
modules: Definitions Of Sociological Terms And Historical
The Rural And The Urban Settings
Definition And Concept Of Rural Sociology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special field of general sociology."
Rural Sociology is a special field of general sociology.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessary input for the proper development of agriculture."
Information is a necessary input for the proper development of agriculture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the settlements that have between 100 and 200 households."
The areas considered rural are the settlements that have between 100 and 200 households.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of many relatively independent families, communities and neighbourhoods."
The rural area is made up of many relatively independent families, communities and neighbourhoods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the social organisation in which education takes place."
The school is the social organisation in which education takes place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most common occupations in Nigerian rural areas."
Agriculture and livestock rearing are the most common occupations in Nigerian rural areas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible to the head of the nearby small town, who in turn is responsible to the Oba of Benin."
The village head is responsible to the head of the nearby small town, who in turn is responsible to the Oba of Benin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important of these inputs."
Land is the most important of these inputs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most significant dimensions of rural life."
The economic institution is one of the most significant dimensions of rural life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in all phases of production."
Labour is used in all phases of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the flow of information between a hierarchically perceived source and a receiver."
Vertical communication is the flow of information between a hierarchically perceived source and a receiver.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic, comprehensive and reliable tool aimed at bringing about desirable rural transformation."
A rural development strategy is a systematic, comprehensive and reliable tool aimed at bringing about desirable rural transformation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a position in the system of social relationships."
Status is a position in the system of social relationships.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic unit of all societies."
The family is the basic unit of all societies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very loose concept however, sometimes conceived narrowly to include only roads and water supply as well as social infrastructure."
Rural Infrastructure is a very loose concept however, sometimes conceived narrowly to include only roads and water supply as well as social infrastructure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the lowest unit in a hierarchy of political arrangement of the district or Emirate."
The Hausa village (Kauye) is the lowest unit in a hierarchy of political arrangement of the district or Emirate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of sociology upon which rural sociologists have their basis."
The concept of rurality is a branch of sociology upon which rural sociologists have their basis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the flow of information between two or more people usually in a face-to-face manner, or by telephone, letter, telex, telegram etc."
Interpersonal communication refers to the flow of information between two or more people usually in a face-to-face manner, or by telephone, letter, telex, telegram etc.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of expectations applied to an occupant of a status and is characterised by certain obligations (functions or duties) and privileges (rights)."
A role is a set of expectations applied to an occupant of a status and is characterised by certain obligations (functions or duties) and privileges (rights).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest authority, consisting of clusters of villages with a common meeting place known as the village centre."
The village group is the highest authority, consisting of clusters of villages with a common meeting place known as the village centre.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to accept fraternal polygamy in which one woman is married to two or more brothers."
The Todas of southern India are known to accept fraternal polygamy in which one woman is married to two or more brothers.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered another essential element in the extension education process which all the extension agents or communicators should be aware of and knowledgeable in."
Communication process is considered another essential element in the extension education process which all the extension agents or communicators should be aware of and knowledgeable in.
fib: ______ is an important aspect of the social life of Nigerians in both rural and urban areas.
Religion
Religion is an important aspect of the social life of Nigerians in both rural and urban areas.
______ is the process of transmitting and acquiring the socially approved aspects of cultural heritage.
Education as an activity
Education as an activity is the process of transmitting and acquiring the socially approved aspects of cultural heritage.
______ is the executive head, although he lacks judicial power.
Sarki
The Sarki is the executive head, although he lacks judicial power.
______ are the geographical and the subject- matter of rural development.
Approaches to rural development
Approaches to rural development are the geographical and the subject- matter of rural development.
______ is a form of social interaction in which the actors seek to obtain scarce rewards by eliminating or weakening other contenders (Ekong 1988).
Conflict
Conflict is a form of social interaction in which the actors seek to obtain scarce rewards by eliminating or weakening other contenders (Ekong 1988).
______ is the manner in which a population distributes itself within the geographical space it occupies.
settlement pattern
A settlement pattern is the manner in which a population distributes itself within the geographical space it occupies.
______ are known to be more imperious than women's sex urge.
Men's sex needs
Men's sex needs are known to be more imperious than women's sex urge.
______ can be defined as a remote area of distance far away from the seat of government; that is, the country side and the people living in villages.
Rural
Rural can be defined as a remote area of distance far away from the seat of government; that is, the country side and the people living in villages.
______ is a process by which messages are transferred from a source to a receiver with a view to modifying the behaviour of the receiver.
Communication
Communication is a process by which messages are transferred from a source to a receiver with a view to modifying the behaviour of the receiver.
______ is the highest, followed by political district and then the group.
Emirate
The Emirate is the highest, followed by political district and then the group.
______ is the major occupation of rural people.
Agriculture
Agriculture is the major occupation of rural people.
______ is a complex assignment which requires full-time staff.
Rural development
Rural development is a complex assignment which requires full-time staff.
______ is a secondary form of marriage and entails no elaborate ceremony.
Levirate marriage
Levirate marriage is a secondary form of marriage and entails no elaborate ceremony.
______ is the study and measurement of recurring phenomena in order to discover the principles by which these phenomena operate.
Rural sociology as a science
Rural sociology as a science is the study and measurement of recurring phenomena in order to discover the principles by which these phenomena operate.
______ is the institution through which the local people show their political expressions, thus like other rural institutions it is highly resistant to change.
local government
The local government is the institution through which the local people show their political expressions, thus like other rural institutions it is highly resistant to change.
______ means such as ostracism and gossips are used or applied to effect control on violation while instant justice is determined in cases of the violation of mores.
Informal
Informal means such as ostracism and gossips are used or applied to effect control on violation while instant justice is determined in cases of the violation of mores.
______ is used for haulage of products from the farm.
Basket
Basket is used for haulage of products from the farm.
______ are the customary rules and behaviours established as standards for guiding a society.
Norms
Norms are the customary rules and behaviours established as standards for guiding a society.
______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
TMA
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is the process of transmitting the socially approved cultural heritage of any society from one generation to another.
Education
Education is the process of transmitting the socially approved cultural heritage of any society from one generation to another.
______ is a social phenomenon which is learned through the collective exercise of members of a society from generation to generation through education and its special forms termed socialisation.
Culture
Culture is a social phenomenon which is learned through the collective exercise of members of a society from generation to generation through education and its special forms termed socialisation.
